srcType.description: Type name to run rollupMetrics on

replace.description:
If `true`, the existing {@link RollupMetricPersistedResult} will be
replaced with the new result.

If `false`, the existing {@link RollupMetricPersistedResult} will be
concatenated with the new result. For example, if the existing
`RollupMetricPersistedResult` has the {@link Timeseries} from `2023-01-01`
to `2023-03-01` and the new result has the timeseries from `2023-02-01` to
`2023-04-01`, `2023-01-01` to `2023-02-01` from the existing
`RollupMetricPersistedResult` will be concatenated with the new result. As
a result, the timeseries in `RollupMetricPersistedResult` will grow in length.

pastIntervals.description:
The number of [intervals](interval) before today that #expressions should
be evaluated for. If left empty, the metric will be evaluated starting
from `2000-01-01T00:00:00Z`.

The number of data points generated is equal to `pastIntervals + futureIntervals + 1`.
For example, if `interval = "DAY", pastIntervals = 4, futureIntervals = 2`,
there will be 7 data points:

  - 4 days ago
  - 3 days ago
  - 2 days ago
  - 1 day ago
  - Today
  - 1 day in the future
  - 2 days in the future

futureIntervals.description:
The number of [intervals](interval) after today that #expressions should be
evaluated for.
